hero.description: PrimeMeals by Renurg Health brings ready-to-eat, medically supportive meals to the doors of eligible New Yorkers — at no cost — through New York's 1115 Medicaid Waiver Social Care Network.
hero.disclaimer: PrimeMeals is not a Social Care Network or SCN provider. We operate as an approved vendor handling meal logistics, preparation, and delivery in coordination with SCN providers.

program.description: PrimeMeals delivers nutritious, ready-to-eat meals to New Yorkers who qualify under the state's 1115 Medicaid Waiver — part of the Social Care Network (SCN) connecting Medicaid members to food and nutrition support.

whoQualifies.title: Made for New Yorkers who need extra support.
whoQualifies.description: Medicaid members enrolled in New York's Social Care Network may be eligible for additional temporary services.

cards.card1: Living with a mental health condition or substance use challenge
cards.card2: Living with an intellectual or developmental disability
cards.card3: Pregnant or recently had a baby
cards.card4: Recently released from incarceration with a chronic health condition
cards.card5: Children and young people with health needs (e.g., asthma, diabetes)
cards.card6: Frequent visits to the emergency room or hospital
cards.card7: Enrolled in a New York State Health Home

whatYouGet.card1Body: Nutritious meals brought directly to your doorstep in New York, on a schedule that works for you.
whatYouGet.card2Body: Fully covered for eligible members through the New York Medicaid SCN program — $0 out of pocket.
whatYouGet.card3Body: Reliable recurring delivery windows so meals arrive predictably and you can plan with confidence.
whatYouGet.card4Body: Chef-prepared, ready-to-eat meals designed around balanced nutrition and dietary health needs.

howItWorks.step1Body: Send us a quick message with your contact details. There's no phone tag — we'll get back to you.
howItWorks.step2Body: We facilitate the eligibility check, coordinate the SCN screening and referral on your behalf, then handle scheduling, preparation, and delivery logistics end-to-end.
howItWorks.step3Body: Once approved, meals start arriving at your door on a consistent delivery schedule.

qualify.description: Tell us a little about yourself. A member of the PrimeMeals team will reach out to confirm your details and guide you through the next steps.
qualify.step1: You send a quick message with your details.
qualify.step2: We follow up to verify eligibility and coordinate your SCN referral.
qualify.step3: Meals begin once approved — weekly, at no cost.
qualify.cardBody: Share a few details and our team will verify your eligibility and coordinate your SCN referral.
qualify.privacy: Private and secure. We only use this information to coordinate your meal support.

footer.description: PrimeMeals is an approved vendor partnering with Social Care Networks to facilitate Home-Delivered Meals under New York's 1115 Medicaid Waiver. PrimeMeals is not an SCN provider.
